faq.a: TinyClaw is a one-click deployment platform for OpenClaw, an open-source AI assistant framework. It lets you deploy your own 24/7 AI assistant connected to Telegram in under 1 minute, without any technical setup.

faq.q: How long does it take to deploy OpenClaw with TinyClaw?
faq.a: Less than 1 minute. Traditional setup takes 60+ minutes of terminal commands. TinyClaw handles all server provisioning, OpenClaw installation, and channel configuration automatically.

faq.q: Which AI models does TinyClaw support?
faq.a: TinyClaw supports Claude Opus 4.6 by Anthropic, GPT-5.2 by OpenAI, and Gemini 3 by Google. You can choose your preferred model during setup.
TinyClaw offers a free 7-day trial. After that, it's $29.99 per month, which includes a dedicated cloud server, 24/7 uptime, automatic updates, and Telegram integration.

faq.q: What can an OpenClaw AI assistant do?
faq.a: OpenClaw can read and summarize emails, draft replies, translate messages, schedule meetings, do your taxes, track expenses, write contracts, research competitors, generate invoices, and thousands more tasks — all via natural language through Telegram.
